priorities.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic is affected by a SQL injection vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user; an attacker could execute arbitrary SQL commands, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

A stack-based buffer overflow in the TOTOLINK A950RG (4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104) Device-Information CGI, via manipulation of the CONTENT_LENGTH argument to infostat.cgi, can be exploited remotely; the exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

Adobe Campaign Classic is affected by a SQL injection vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user; a low-privileged attacker could exploit it with no user interaction required, and the scope is changed.

model.name: Google DeepMind Genie 4
model.summary: Google DeepMind's Genie 4, announced October 27, is a world model that generates interactive, photorealistic simulated environments in real time, with native audio — music, ambient sound and character dialogue — generated alongside the scene. Users steer it with keyboard controls and natural-language prompts; it is rolling out first as a research preview for trusted testers, then to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie.
